d: The Aginode LANmark-OF Slimflex Singlemode Fiber Patch Cord is designed for high-performance indoor optical networking applications, including enterprise LANs, data centers, and Fiber-to-the-Desk (FTTD) deployments. It features duplex LC/UPC connectors on both ends with bend-insensitive GIGAliteFLEX singlemode fiber for improved cable management in high-density installations. The LSZH jacket enhances safety in indoor environments, while the slim 2.0 mm duplex cable construction provides excellent flexibility and reduced bend radius. The patch cord supports high-speed optical Ethernet applications such as 1GBase-LX and 10GBase-LR and is manufactured to international fiber optic standards.
